audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of both Pam house-upgrade events and every anonymous, credited, gift, behavioral, and Penny-spouse branch. Every spoken line, player response, craft detail, payment and anonymity statement, family reconciliation, poverty reference, spouse-specific line, and repeated passage was reviewed in full event context against the canonical Ukrainian glossary. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, conversation topics, fork destinations, placeholders, gender branches, dialogue delimiters, emotion markers, music and sound IDs, and all non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. Remaining Town records and full-locale final audits remain pending.
